definitions.gloss: pagan; heathen; follower of a different religion
definitions.explanation: A person who follows a religion different from one's own, or who does not belong to the speaker's faith. Often carries a historical or religious-conflict connotation, as in accounts of crusades or missionary work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}らは{異教徒|いきょうと}とみなされた。
{中世|ちゅうせい}には{異教徒|いきょうと}への{迫害|はくがい}があった。
examples.english: In the Middle Ages there was persecution of nonbelievers.

examples.japanese: その{王|おう}は{異教徒|いきょうと}を{改宗|かいしゅう}させようと{宣教師|せんきょうし}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: The king sent missionaries to try to convert the heathens.

notes:
Refers to a follower of a religion other than one's own, especially in historical or religious-conflict contexts. Composed of {異|い} (different) + {教|きょう} (religion, teaching) + {徒|と} (follower).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異教徒|いきょうと}とみなす: to regard as a pagan
- {異教徒|いきょうと}への{迫害|はくがい}: persecution of nonbelievers
- {異教徒|いきょうと}を{改宗|かいしゅう}させる: to convert the heathens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {異教|いきょう}: paganism; a different religion — the belief system, not the person
- {無神論者|むしんろんしゃ}: atheist — one who denies the existence of any god, not merely a different faith
